snippet.title: War Tech Fighters - Trailer (PC)
snippet.description:
Buy Now - https://www.greenmangaming.com/games/war-tech-fighters/

War Tech Fighters is a space action game where giant mechs battle against the Zatros empire in a desperate struggle for survival. Coming to Early Access on August 16th 2017

Developed by Drakkar Dev
Published by Green Man Gaming Publishing

Green Man Gaming Publishing - publisher of fine independent PC games. Games such as Aporia: Beyond The Valley, Stormworks: Build and Rescue, The Black Death, Stable Orbit, and much more.
